name: Chronostacia
source:
"There are only 99 days left until the world ends.
I wonder who I'll be with when I hear the last grain of sand fall——"

Watched over by the "Giant Hourglass of The World Tree", the grand capital of Albion boasts great splendour.

10 years ago, by means of the "Time Revolution", methods to control and manage time propagated. All humans gave their time to "BANK", the time bank, to look after, or sold their time and rejoiced in lives of luxury. Before humanity knew it, "time" was no longer something that was "irreplaceable".

17-year-old Lucia (the protagonist) has no memory of her childhood. Even so, she lives a fun and quiet life helping her uncle out at his café.

One day, big news began to spread throughout the capital like a wildfire...

"The time that was stored in BANK was stolen by an unknown organization. There's only 99 days left until the world ends!"

As the city's lively atmosphere was slowly changing to that of  bewilderment and confusion, Lucia happens upon "a small hourglass". After the hourglass sheds a faint light in her hands, it gifts her with a certain power.

That power is to stop time with her thoughts, "Chronostasis".

The story comes to life in a city with an atmosphere like that of after a lively festival, coupled with the feelings of Lucia and her "precious somebody".

[Translation of the [url=http://www.otomate.jp/chronostacia/#/story]official website's plot summary[/url]]
translation:
“距离世界末日只剩下99天了。
我不知道当我听到最后一粒沙落下时，我会和谁在一起——”

在“世界树的巨大沙漏”的守护下，阿尔比恩的宏伟都城显得无比辉煌。

10年前，通过“时间革命”，控制和管理时间的方法得到传播。所有的人类都把自己的时间交给“BANK”，即时间银行来照顾，或者卖掉自己的时间，享受奢侈的生活。在人类意识到之前，“时间”不再是“不可替代”的东西。

17岁的露西亚（主人公）对童年没有任何记忆。即便如此，她仍然过着有趣而安静的生活，在叔叔的咖啡馆里帮忙。

某一天，重大消息开始如野火般传遍京城……

“BANK中存储的时间被不明组织盗走，距离世界末日只剩下99天了！”

当城市的热闹气氛慢慢转变为迷茫和困惑时，露西亚偶然发现了“一个小沙漏”。沙漏在她手中发出微弱的光芒后，赋予了她某种力量。

这种力量就是用她的意念让时间停止，“时间静止”。

故事发生在一座充满节日气氛的城市，以及露西亚和她的“宝贝”的感情。

[翻译的[url=http://www.otomate.jp/chronostacia/#/story]官网剧情概要[/url]]
